description.narrative: Capacity development on SRHR with focus on the right to safe and legal abortions and LGBTI-issues.
Kompetensutveckling inom SRHR med fokus på rätten till säker och laglig abort och HBTQ-frågor
The objective of the contribution is to conduct Values Clarification and Attitude Transformation (VCAT) workshops for Regional SRHR team´s partner organisations and Embassies in the region.

Ten workshops were conducted for staff in Swedish Embassies (Zambia and Tanzania) and partners (UNFPA, UN general, IPAS, African Population and Health Research Center) with in total 296 participants. Three workshops were cancelled due to Covid-19. A brief survey among the participants show that the workshops and the tools developed have increased support for and understanding of abortion and LGBTIQ+ rights as critical components of any SRHR strategy. The training curriculum has been formalized into a toolkit: Values Clarification on Abortion and LGBTIQ+ Issues, based on 12 activities designed to be delivered over two days including three newly developed activities based on the feedback of participants. This formalized toolkit will amplify the impact of the workshops and expand the number of staff at national and global agencies that are able to be reached and supported to help advance abortion and LGBTIQ+ rights. It will serve as an important resource to support and advance Sweden’s feminist foreign policy objectives in sexual and reproductive health and rights and well as SRHR more broadly.
